verdict.rationale: The only first-party evidence of free use is the browser MCP inspector, which needs no login, so you can test tool connections before paying. However, no documented free tier or plan limits appear in the pack. A community report says a credit card was required for rebuild/release on hosted servers, and that this was undocumented, which suggests hosting and deployment prototyping is not free. Missing for 10: a documented free plan with stated limits, free hosting or Gateway usage for prototyping, clear disclosure of when payment is required, and independent confirmation that the free tier is meaningful.
